title: Chapter 84 The Girl With Unknown Origin
content:
Chapter 84 The Girl With Unknown Origin

The next moment, a slightly immature little head poked in.

It looked like a sixteen-year-old girl.

Seeing the woman, Lu Xue was slightly stunned.

"Who are you?"

Seeing that there were really people in the city, the woman was obviously a little excited, and then walked in with interest.

While walking, she also looked at the environment in the city.

Suddenly, her eyes were shining.

"Wow! This city is so great!"

At this time, the woman had walked not far in front of Lu Xue.

"Do you live here?"

The woman looked at Lu Xue and asked.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded slightly, and stared at this somewhat familiar guy with a somewhat vigilant look.

"How did you get in?"

Lu Xue asked in confusion.

This city has a ban set by her father, and someone can still come in.

Could it be this guy?

! ! !

Could this guy be her father's illegitimate daughter? !

Suddenly, Lu Xue looked at the woman with more vigilance.

The woman was a little stunned when she noticed Lu Xue's gaze. What's going on? Why are you looking at me like this?

"Hello, my name is Gongsun Yao, I come from, from another star field."

At this time, the woman said with a smile.

"Gongsun Yao? Isn't your last name Lu?"

After hearing Gongsun Yao's words, Lu Xue was stunned.

"What? Why do I have to be last name Lu?"

Gongsun Yao scratched her head, her face full of question marks.

Why did she change her last name just to go out?

"Ahaha, nothing, nothing, my name is Lu Xue, this is the Wasteland City, welcome, welcome."

After Lu Xue realized it, her face suddenly turned red, and she waved her hand and smiled.

It turned out that she was overthinking.

How could her father be that kind of person?

No, no.

"Wasteland City? Why are there only a few people in this city?"

Gongsun Yao looked at the surrounding environment and was immediately puzzled.

Hearing this, Lu Xue frowned slightly. How did she know that there was more than one person in this city.

The next moment, a figure appeared beside Lu Xue.

It was Qin Yi.

At this time, Qin Yi looked at Gongsun Yao with a serious expression.

However, no matter how he looked, he could not see through the other party.

At this moment, the other party was like a hazy.

"Miss Lu Xue, be careful, this person is not simple."

Qin Yi said with a serious expression.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned, turned her head to look at Gongsun Yao who looked harmless, and then nodded and said: "Okay, I know."

"Hey, what are you talking about, I'm still here!"

Seeing the two people whispering there, Gongsun Yao was a little angry.

It's too contemptuous.

Hearing this, Qin Yi turned his head to look at Gongsun Yao.

"Miss, I wonder why you came to my deserted city?"

"Oh, nothing, I'm just free, but I think your city is nice, can I stay here for a while?"

Then, Gongsun Yao looked at Qin Yi with hopeful eyes.

As if to say, you should agree quickly!

Hearing Gongsun Yao's words, Qin Yi hesitated.

It's true that Gongsun Yao's origin is unknown and a little dangerous.

After a moment of silence, Qin Yi shook his head, "Sorry, girl, the city is not open yet, and outsiders are not welcome."

Seeing that she was rejected, Gongsun Yao was stunned for a moment, and then her eyes were red.

The next moment, Gongsun Yao actually cried on the spot.

"Wuwuwu, to be honest, I have been an orphan since I was a child, and I have been wandering outside alone. Now I have finally found such a good place, but you still don't accept me. Wuwu, can you really bear to let a little girl like me wander the streets and be homeless?"

This can be said to be a big price to pay, and both parents evaporated directly.

Seeing Gongsun Yao's acting skills, Qin Yi's mouth twitched slightly.

Who would believe these words?

Just lie to the children.

Just when Qin Yi was about to refuse again, Lu Xue on the side suddenly choked up.

"Wuwuwu, you, you are too pitiful."

Hearing Gongsun Yao's words, Lu Xue immediately recalled the time when she and her father depended on each other for life.

At that time, Lu Daosheng had not yet become the lord of the deserted city, but took her to wander around.

Life was very bitter.

But even so, Lu Daosheng still gave her the best.

Seeing Lu Xue also began to cry, Qin Yi stood there in astonishment.

Miss, did you believe it? !

In front of him, Gongsun Yao, who was crying, was stunned when she heard Lu Xue's sobbing. This was the first time someone believed her lies.

She then began to cry even louder.

Later, the two of them hugged and cried.

Leaving Qin Yi standing alone in the wind.

As expected, with Lu Xue's permission, Gongsun Yao successfully stayed and lived with Lu Xue in the deserted city.

But Qin Yi and others did not slack off in their vigilance against Gongsun Yao.

Because Gongsun Yao had too many doubts.

As long as Gongsun Yao made any unusual moves, they would take action without hesitation, and even directly use the backup plan left by Lu Daosheng in the deserted city.

After all, Lu Daosheng was confident in handing over this deserted city to them for management, and they had to take responsibility.

As for Lu Xue, to be honest, they were just afraid that Lu Xue would leave here. As for Lu Xue's safety, haha, let me exaggerate.

Now even if this city exploded on the spot.

If they all died, Lu Xue would probably be fine.

For Lu Xue, she was quite happy because she was no longer lonely here.

Unfortunately, she didn't notice that Gongsun Yao looked at Lu Xue with a strange look.

.........

Wuling Star Domain, on Wushen Mountain.

At this time, Jiang Bei was still keeping his movements from three months ago and sitting cross-legged on the ground.

On the side, Yu Qingfeng was waiting on the side.

Looking at Jiangbei, Yu Qingfeng shook his head.

These days, he has been staying with him and just waiting by Jiangbei with peace of mind.

Anyway, he has nothing to do.

As for Lu Daosheng, he has long disappeared.

After all, Lu Daosheng would not just wait for Jiangbei here.

Buzz —

Suddenly, a breath suddenly overflowed from Jiangbei's body.

Feeling the movement, Yu Qingfeng's expression lit up and he quickly turned his head to look at Jiangbei.

Could it be?

At this moment, Jiang Bei suddenly opened his eyes, with endless vicissitudes in his eyes.

"I see."

boom!

Suddenly, Jiangbei's aura began to become terrifying, a little stronger than before.

Immediately, Jiangbei slowly stood up.

"Jiangbei, are you okay?"

On the side, Yu Qingfeng looked at Jiangbei and said in surprise.

Hearing this, Jiang Bei nodded slightly.

The next moment, a figure appeared in front of Jiangbei in an instant.

"Did you figure it out?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Jiang Bei at this time and said with a smile.

"I figured it out."

"Senior, can you attack me once?"

Hearing this, Yu Qingfeng, who was standing beside him, was stunned. He was about to say something, but was interrupted by Jiang Bei's head.

"Brother Yu, thank you for your hard work these days, please retreat a little further. If you don't succeed today, you will be successful."

Jiang Bei said firmly.

Upon hearing this, Yu Qingfeng was silent for a moment, nodded and said, "Okay."

Then Yu Qingfeng retreated outside Wushen Mountain.

At this time, countless cultivators gathered at the foot of the mountain, all of whom came for Jiangbei.

"Look, someone has come out of the mountain!"

"How could he fly on Wushen Mountain? Could it be that he is Wushen?!"

As we all know, flying is forbidden on Wushen Mountain.

Of course, you can try it if you have the strength.

But most of them cannot be done.

When they heard someone say it was a martial god, everyone looked at Yu Qingfeng with respect.

"No, that's not a martial god. I've seen the martial god, but the martial god is not that ugly."

Yu Qingfeng:...
